class.name: Spline2DControl
class.brief_description: Full Editor & Runtime composite UI control for `Spline2DResource`.
class.description: Full Editor & Runtime composite UI control for `Spline2DResource`. Combines 2D shape presets, `Spline2DCanvas`, and the alternating 2D Point/Section chain. Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
